WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg AS transaction_reference,
    t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_reference,
    order_type_mix,
    avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    avg_option_volume_ratio,
    AVG(avg_short_interest_days_to_cover) OVER (
      PARTITION BY order_type_mix
    ) AS order_type_baseline_short_interest
  FROM transaction_averages
)
SELECT
  transaction_reference,
  order_type_mix,
  avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  avg_option_volume_ratio,
  avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / NULLIF(order_type_baseline_short_interest, 0)
    AS short_interest_to_baseline_ratio
FROM with_baseline
ORDER BY short_interest_to_baseline_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A transaction's average is computed across all its matched sentiment snapshots; the baseline equally weights transactions in the same order type mix, excluding transactions with missing average short interest because AVG ignores NULLs.
